title: Halle Berry Had to Clear Up Her Own Engagement News on Live TV — Here's What Really Happened
metaDescription: Halle Berry confirmed her engagement to Van Hunt on 'The Tonight Show' — after first having to correct a rumor that she'd turned him down.
altText: Relationships news illustration for: Halle Berry Had to Clear Up Her Own Engagement News on Live TV — Here's What Really Happened
html:
Halle Berry's engagement announcement came with a plot twist most couples don't have to deal with: she had to publicly deny turning her partner down before she could confirm she'd actually said yes.

Appearing on "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon" on February 5, 2026, the Oscar winner addressed swirling confusion about her engagement to musician Van Hunt, whom she's been dating for nearly six years. "I did not say no," Berry clarified. "We just don't have a date. But of course I said yes, I would marry him!"

The correction suggests the couple's engagement had already leaked or been reported in a garbled form before Berry got the chance to tell the story her way — a common hazard for anyone dating in the public eye long enough. What is confirmed: after roughly six years together, Berry and Hunt are engaged, even if a wedding date hasn't been set.

Berry's relationship history has been closely tracked by tabloids for decades, making her low-key, multi-year romance with Hunt something of an outlier — a long relationship that largely avoided public drama until the engagement news itself got tangled up in a rumor. For now, the only confirmed detail is the one Berry stated herself, on camera: the answer was yes.
